tokens.name: ink

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Supporting text: subtitles, metadata, captions. 5.1:1 on canvas, 5.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Icons and placeholder text only, never body copy (3.2:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled states, demo-data footnotes at 10px+ and hairline dividers. Not for meaningful text.

tokens.usage: App and page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: inactive icon wells, empty-state circles, secondary chip backgrounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card outlines on canvas.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Brand warmth: the app-icon ground (as peach-soft), blobs, highlight fills, the hero headline accent on photos.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: App-icon background, empty-state gradients, the 'needs booking' card tint.

tokens.name: peach-pale
tokens.usage: Very light warm tint for banners on canvas.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The egg dot in the logo and accent fills (badges, the 'needs booking' tile). Not for text: 3.0:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Accent text and eyebrows on canvas or peach-soft (5.7:1 on canvas, 5.1:1 on peach-soft).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons, for example 'scheduled' state. 6.3:1 on info-bg.

tokens.name: caution

tokens.name: shadow-glass

tokens.name: logo-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width of the nest letters in a 64-unit box (1/8 of the box), with round caps and joins.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things that arrive, settle or are thrown: the sheet sliding in, a sheet settling after a handle drag, a list row closing, a card snapping back or flying off.

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer-like exits (a sheet leaving). Not used yet; for the sheet-exit item.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state (scale 0.95) and small toggles like the settings switch.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: Reduced motion: sheets, scrim and a decision fade instead of moving; a leaving row fades.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Scrim, toast and dialog in; sheet and scrim out; a sheet settling; a list row closing. Also the reduced-motion cap for fades.

tokens.name: duration-snap
tokens.usage: A dragged card snapping back to the middle.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet sliding in.

tokens.name: duration-card
tokens.usage: The next card coming up into place.

tokens.name: duration-fling
tokens.usage: A decided card flying off screen (the buttons and keys; the longest a drag's fling takes).

tokens.name: duration-fling-quick
tokens.usage: The shortest flight of a flicked card: a drag's fling takes the time its release speed gives, between this and duration-fling.
